invariant: Technical delivery process with one immutable effect payload and multiple attempt records. Attempt identity is state, never a new unconstrained process owner.
mustPreserve: Retry same invitation ID with exact terms returns original acceptance; changed terms conflict. New invitation generation is independent. Delivery retries preserve exact token and accepted at-least-once policy.
technicalStateToSeparate: SMTP attempts, provider responses and delivery retries
logicalPhysicalRule: Logical technical responsibility is separate from physical storage/owner. Existing native operational journals may remain where required for exact recovery; this inventory does not require conversion to KV/CAS or count them as business authority.
